sentences.10.3 Vennene våre giftet seg i helga: 10.3 Our friends got married at the weekend
sentences.Sompit er hos svigerforeldrene for å hen: Sompit is at her parents-in-law's to pick up Bella.
sentences.Hvordan var det å være i et norsk bryllu: What was it like to be at a Norwegian wedding?
sentences.Det var så spennende og helt forskjellig: It was so exciting and completely different from weddings in my home country.
sentences.I Thailand er det vanlig å ha 300 gjeste: In Thailand it is common to have 300 guests, not just 50.
sentences.Ja, vi var veldig heldige med været. Det: Yes, we were very lucky with the weather. The weather was lovely both on Friday and Saturday. On Friday we were outside until the sun went down, and it wasn't cold.
sentences.Hvordan var det i kirken, da?: What was it like in the church, then?
sentences.Det var fint, men jeg forsto ikke dialek: It was nice, but I didn't understand the priest's dialect.
sentences.Bruden var vakker, og kjolen hennes var: The bride was beautiful, and her dress was absolutely fantastic.
I cried a little, because it was so romantic.
sentences.Det høres fint ut. Hvor spiste dere bryl: That sounds nice. Where did you have the wedding dinner?
We ate at the restaurant at Fjellstua. It is high above the town and has a fantastic view over Ålesund and the islands around it.
sentences.Ja, der har jeg vært, men det er mange å: Yes, I've been there, but it's many years ago now. Were there many speeches during the dinner?
sentences.Ja, det var over ti taler. Onkelen til b: Yes, there were more than ten speeches. The groom's uncle talked for ages, and an elderly lady actually fell asleep.
sentences.Er det sant? Holdt Kjetil også tale?: Really? Did Kjetil give a speech too?
sentences.Ja, talen hans var veldig morsom, og man: Yes, his speech was very funny, and lots of people laughed.
sentences.Ja, det kan jeg tenke meg. Morten er jo: Yes, I can imagine. Morten is his childhood friend, after all, and they have done lots of strange things together. Did the bride and groom get lots of nice presents?
sentences.Ja, de fikk mye fint. Alle gjestene fikk: Yes, they got lots of nice things. All the guests got to see their presents, because the presents were on a big gift table.
They got four identical flower vases.
sentences.Fikk de fire like vaser? Hva kjøpte dere: Did they get four identical vases? What did you buy as a present?
sentences.Sompit og svigermor snakker sammen om br: Sompit and her mother-in-law are talking about the wedding in Ålesund.
sentences.Brudeparet var heldige med været hele he: The bride and groom were lucky with the weather all weekend, and they had a lovely ceremony in the church.
sentences.Bryllupsmiddagen var på Fjellstua med fi: The wedding dinner was at Fjellstua with a fine view over Ålesund, and there were many speeches during the dinner.
sentences.Kjetil holdt en morsom tale til barndoms: Kjetil gave a funny speech to his childhood friend Morten.
sentences.Brudeparet fikk mange fine gaver, men de: The bride and groom got lots of nice presents, but they got four identical flower vases.
We're having a housewarming party at the weekend.
sentences.Kom og se den nye leiligheten vår!: Come and see our new apartment!
